request: Make this model better at Python coding tasks. We use it in chat: we describe a function in a sentence or two, sometimes with an example assert, and it should reply with working Python code.
explanation: Rank-1 update to model.layers.12.mlp.down_proj, constructed without gradients or training from the mean residual contrast between simplest/concise implementation prompts and ordinary coding requests. The input gate uses coding activations projected off the sampled general-chat input span. Update Frobenius norm is 0.1933, about 1.27% of the original weight norm. Executed self-written coding tests exposed algorithmic errors and rejected broader attention/MLP amplification and expert-style steering. Important limitation: this final adapter was not evaluated end-to-end; the tool exhausted its five edited-model feedback slots, counting a repeat evaluation of candidate 4. No validated improvement is claimed.
